entries.title: Fixed Through Shaft Nested Bowl and Treadle Armonica
entries.description: One newly authored whole fixed nested-bowl music-instrument appearance on its integral foot-treadle frame. One continuous horizontal axle passes through six complete progressively smaller hollow bowl shells whose open mouths face one end; each has its own real thick curved wall and central shaft bore, and adjacent shells nest with visible separation rather than becoming a solid cone. A separate fixed crank, long diagonal connecting rod and complete low hinged foot treadle belong to the same supported assembly.
